name: Sage
description: A hardy evergreen perennial with soft, pebbled, velvet-textured gray-green leaves and a pungent, savory aroma.
use: Butter sauces and tea. Classic pairing with roasted squashes, stuffing, and browned butter pasta dishes.
tips: Prefers warm, sunny environments with moderate watering. Replace or propagate woody plants every 3 to 4 years for tender foliage.
